title: Diagnose an incident from logs
summary: Đọc log tiếng Anh, tách signal khỏi noise và viết chẩn đoán có bằng chứng.
learningObjectives: Đề xuất kiểm tra tiếp theo

exercises.question: Dòng nào là bằng chứng mạnh nhất cho nguyên nhân gần?
exercises.explanation: Dòng này nêu resource đã chạm giới hạn, liên hệ trực tiếp với lỗi 503.

performanceTask.title: Write an evidence-based diagnosis
performanceTask.scenario: Checkout trả 503 và bạn cần gửi chẩn đoán ban đầu cho on-call engineer.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Read the log once, hide it, then write the initial diagnosis in English from memory.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Viết symptom, probable cause, evidence và next verification step. Phân biệt fact với hypothesis.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Checkout request 91 returned HTTP 503. The strongest signal is that all 50 database connections were active immediately before the failure. This suggests pool exhaustion, although the logs do not yet prove why connections were retained. Next, compare pool wait time and connection release metrics before and after the latest deploy.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Sửa chẩn đoán để mỗi hypothesis có evidence và một bước kiểm chứng.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Log khác cho thấy memory tăng rồi pod bị OOMKilled. Viết chẩn đoán và bước xác minh tiếp theo.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Từ một unseen log mới, tóm tắt fact, hypothesis và verification step sau khi source đã ẩn.

extractionItems.question: What is the observed symptom?
options: Oldest message age breached five minutes
extractionItems.correctAnswer: Oldest message age breached five minutes
extractionItems.feedback: The SLA line and oldest age are observations.

extractionItems.question: Which signal supports the nearest hypothesis?
options: Consumers dropped from twelve to two
extractionItems.correctAnswer: Consumers dropped from twelve to two
extractionItems.feedback: Reduced consumer capacity can explain the growing queue.

extractionItems.question: What should be checked next?
extractionItems.feedback: This check can confirm or reject the capacity hypothesis.

readingLadder.applicationPrompt: Explain fact → cautious hypothesis → falsifiable check, then apply it to an unfamiliar timeout log.
applicationChecklist: I kept facts separate from hypotheses.
I proposed a check that could disprove the hypothesis.

rubric.label: Observed symptom
rubric.description: Names the failure and relevant context accurately.

rubric.label: Evidence-backed hypothesis
rubric.description: Connects a log signal to a cautious probable cause.

rubric.label: Verification step
rubric.description: Proposes a concrete next check that could confirm or reject the hypothesis.
